With its dazzling waves and charming vistas it's a great place to relax.

scripts.text: The transit fee is 10,000 Zeny and 1,000 for VIP.
scripts.translation: 船费为10,000 Zeny，VIP票价为1,000 Zeny。

scripts.text: ^8B4513Dewata^000000 is a beautiful and peaceful island country.
scripts.translation: 德瓦他是一个美丽而宁静的岛国。 ^8B4513^000000

scripts.text: What's wrong with your faaaaaace? You must really be clueless!
scripts.translation: 你那是什么表情啊——？看来你还真是一窍不通！

scripts.text: Let me drop some knowledge on ya.
scripts.translation: 让我给你普及点知识吧。

scripts.text: I may be a youngling, but no one knows more than I do about ^777700Palm fruit^000000. All right! What do you want to know?
scripts.translation: 我年纪虽小，但说起棕榈果，可没人比我更懂！好啦，你想知道什么？ ^777700^000000

scripts.text: So you want to know about Palm fruit's pulp? Let me explain.
scripts.translation: 想了解棕榈果的果肉？那我给你讲讲。

scripts.text: Normally Palm fruit shell is used for making oil. Palm Oil is a useful ingredient for many dishes.
scripts.translation: 通常棕榈果的果壳用来榨油。棕榈油是许多菜肴的常用原料。

scripts.text: Hmm... Have you met Memo already? Then it should be easy for you to understand.
scripts.translation: 嗯...你已经见过梅莫了？那就好理解了。

scripts.text: If you want to know how to use Palm Oil, go find Memo on the north side of Dewata island. Everyday, he makes traditional drinks with Palm Oil.
scripts.translation: 想知道棕榈油怎么用，就去德瓦他岛北边找梅莫。他每天都用棕榈油制作传统饮品。

scripts.text: Anyways, we refer to the oil that comes from the Palm fruit as Palm oil or Coconut oil, which is well known for it's quality.
scripts.translation: 总之，从棕榈果里榨出的油，我们叫它棕榈油，也叫椰子油。这种油的品质可是出了名的好。

scripts.text: The leftovers from oil production gets dried, and used for fuel in cooking or heating.
scripts.translation: 榨油后的残渣会被晒干，用作烹饪或取暖的燃料。

scripts.text: It burns well and has a good smell, can't get better than that.
scripts.translation: 它好烧，又有香味，简直没得挑！

scripts.text: Ok!! That is all about the pulp, it takes too long to explain all those useful effects for Palm fruit shells.
scripts.translation: 好啦！！果肉就介绍到这里。棕榈果壳的用处那么多，全讲完可太费时间了。

scripts.text: It's not like this is the extent of my knowledge. Don't get me wrong!
scripts.translation: 别误会，我的知识可不止这些！

scripts.text: So you want to know about the Palm interior? Let me explain.
scripts.translation: 想了解棕榈果的内部？那我给你讲讲。

scripts.text: Palm tree fruit has 2 layers of pulp. Outside is very rough, and the inside is smooth...
scripts.translation: 棕榈果的果肉有两层，外面很粗糙，里面却很光滑...

scripts.text: Hmm... Yes! the pulp of Palm tree fruit is a little bit harder than a walnut shell, must be the water it contains inside.
scripts.translation: 嗯...没错！棕榈果的果肉比核桃壳还硬一点，大概是因为里面装着水吧。

scripts.text: Inside of the shell, there's about 300cc water which is useful in quenching people's thirst since Dewata island has very hot weather.
scripts.translation: 果壳里面大约有300毫升的水。德瓦他岛天气这么热，喝了正好解渴。

scripts.text: And it's not like we just throw it away once we drink the water inside!!
scripts.translation: 而且，喝完里面的水后，我们可不会直接把它扔掉！！

scripts.text: We also can make a quality canteen out of it! Like I said, it has really thick outer shell enough and can act as a water bottle.
scripts.translation: 还能用来做个好水壶呢！我说过，它的外壳很厚实，拿来当水瓶正合适。

scripts.text: It is also great to make charcoal. Charcoal made out of palm fruit is well known for long lasting and quality fire,
scripts.translation: 拿它烧炭也很不错。棕榈果做的木炭烧得久、火力好，可是很有名的。

scripts.text: People love to cook seafoods and chicken with Palm fruit charcoal..
scripts.translation: 人们喜欢用棕榈果木炭来烤海鲜和鸡肉...

scripts.text: It has the extra bonus of being burning with a pleasant palm smell
scripts.translation: 而且烧起来还会带着好闻的棕榈香味呢。

scripts.text: Ok!! That is all for pulp information, it takes too long to explain all those useful effects.
scripts.translation: 好啦！！果肉就介绍到这里。所有用途都讲完可太费时间了。

scripts.text: It's not like this is all I know. Don't get me wrong!
scripts.translation: 别误会，我知道的可不止这些！

scripts.text: So, you want to know about tender kernel inside? Let me explain for you
scripts.translation: 想了解里面柔软的果仁？那我给你讲讲。

scripts.text: The kernel inside of the hard pulp is used as a natural digestive.
scripts.translation: 坚硬果肉里面的果仁，可以用来帮助消化。

scripts.text: Not much to say about the kernel inside..
scripts.translation: 里面的果仁嘛，也没多少可说的...

scripts.text: but we do make sure to use every part of the palm fruit.
scripts.translation: 不过，棕榈果的每个部分，我们可都利用上了。

scripts.text: Arrgg! You have no interest in the world!
scripts.translation: 啊啊！你怎么对什么都没兴趣！

scripts.text: Why are you carrying so much? Isn't it heavy?
scripts.translation: 你怎么背了这么多东西？不重吗？

up, and my throat is parched!

I hope you behave like a noble

scripts.text: Need info about our foods? Well... I don't have much to talk about, but feel free to listen if you want.
scripts.translation: 想了解我们的食物？嗯...我也没多少可说的，不过你想听的话就听听吧。

scripts.text: So much to cover, let me begin.
scripts.translation: 内容很多，让我从头说起。

scripts.text: First, Dewata dishes have special names based on each cooking recipe,
scripts.translation: 首先，德瓦他的菜名会根据做法来取。

scripts.text: If dish name has 'Goreng' in it, then it is either stir or deep fried food.
scripts.translation: 如果菜名里有“Goreng”，那就是炒或炸的食物。

scripts.text: If it is a type of 'Bakar', then it is a grilled food.
scripts.translation: 如果是“Bakar”类的，那就是烤制的食物。

scripts.text: And if it's 'Satay', then you are eating a skewered dish.
scripts.translation: 如果是“Satay”，那就是串烧料理。

scripts.text: Second, we have dishes named after basic ingredients,
scripts.translation: 其次，有些菜是按主要食材来命名的。

scripts.text: In Dewata island, we call rice as Nasi, noodle as Mie, bread as Roti, chicken as Ayam, fish as Ikan, and corn as Jagung.
scripts.translation: 在德瓦他岛上，我们称米饭为Nasi，面条为Mie，面包为Roti，鸡肉为Ayam，鱼为Ikan，玉米为Jagung。

scripts.text: So, if rice is fried we call it 'Nasi Goreng', and fried noodle is 'Mie Goreng'.
scripts.translation: 所以，炒米饭叫“Nasi Goreng”，炒面叫“Mie Goreng”。

scripts.text: Well... This is enough to enjoy our foods in Dewata!! If you are hungry, we have our special set menu for only ^0000FF5000^000000 Zeny.
scripts.translation: 嗯...知道这些，就能尽情享用德瓦他的美食了！肚子饿的话，我们有特制套餐，只要5000 Zeny。 ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: We have 2 items 'Nasi Goreng' and 'Satay'. Which one do you want?

scripts.text: This is Nasi Goreng fried with my special sauce plus egg fry on the top. It only costs ^0000FF5000^000000 Zeny.
scripts.translation: 这是用我的特制酱汁炒出的印度尼西亚什锦炒饭，上面还盖着一个煎蛋。只要5000 Zeny。 ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: This is the Satay, a slice of meat skewered and grilled over Palm fruit charcoal. It costs only ^0000FF5000^000000 Zeny.

scripts.text: This temple behind me is called Borobudur.
scripts.translation: 我身后的这座寺庙叫婆罗浮

scripts.text: Borobudur temple was built in the 9th century
to venerate the Great Buddha, an ancient religious figure.
scripts.translation: 了供奉古老的宗教人物大佛而建的。

scripts.text: This temple is made with 6 square platforms and 3 round platforms, and 2672 hand carved relief panels as well as 504 statue of various Buddhas.
scripts.translation: 这座寺庙由6层方形平台和3层圆形平台组成，有2672块手工雕刻的浮雕，以及504尊形态各异的佛像。

scripts.text: The central stupa, or shrine is located at the center of high platform, which is surrounded by 72 more statues.
scripts.translation: 中央的佛塔，也就是神龛，位于最高平台的中心，周围还环绕着72尊佛像。

scripts.text: Even in modern times Borobudur temple is a pilgrimage site for many monks worshiping the Buddha. It's also a major tourist attraction, as you can imagine.
scripts.translation: 直到今天，婆罗浮屠寺仍是许多僧侣朝拜佛陀的圣地。想必各位也猜到了，这里也是一处著名的旅游景点。

scripts.text: I am a monk, content to spend my days in religious study.
scripts.translation: 我是一名僧人，每日潜心修行，乐在其中。

scripts.text: I've just returned from a pilgrimage to Borobudur temple with my fellow monks...
scripts.translation: 我刚和同门的僧人们一起从婆罗浮屠寺朝圣回来...

scripts.text: Borobudur temple has many pilgrims visiting, since it is one of few temples left for worshipping the Great Buddha.
scripts.translation: 婆罗浮屠寺是仅存的少数几座供奉大佛的寺庙之一，所以有很多朝圣者前来。

scripts.text: Borobudur temple is one of few temples left for worshiping the Great Buddha.
scripts.translation: 婆罗浮屠寺是仅存的少数几座供奉大佛的寺庙之一。

scripts.text: I don't understand why there are only few temples left that follow our ways...
scripts.translation: 我不明白，为什么遵循我们教义的寺庙只剩下这么几座了...

scripts.text: Are you a Tourist? You can make an offering and a wish to one of the shrines.
scripts.translation: 你是游客吗？可以去神龛前献上供品，许个愿。

scripts.text: Our great Buddha may grant your wish..
scripts.translation: 我们的大佛或许会实现你的愿望...

scripts.text: Our great Buddha is the king of souls and the leader of all good Gods.
scripts.translation: 我们的大佛是众灵之王，也是所有善神的领袖。

scripts.text: The Dewata tribes believes in Buddha, the strange thing is they all describe Buddha as different creatures.
scripts.translation: 德瓦他的各个部落都信仰佛陀。奇怪的是，他们把佛陀描绘成了不同的生灵。

scripts.text: I'm not really sure about the reason for that. Maybe because there are many different tribes in Dewata with different characteristics.
scripts.translation: 原因我也不太清楚。也许是因为德瓦他部落众多，各有各的特点吧。

scripts.text: There is a small shrine here. There are many people making wishes.

scripts.translation: 哦，原来是游客。这里是供奉大佛的“宝塔”。请勿打扰在此祈祷的僧人。 ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: We have a pagoda for the worship of Buddhas. Each temple has one of these towers, though not many people come here besides other monks.
scripts.translation: 这是一座供奉佛陀的宝塔。每座寺庙都有这样一座塔，不过除了僧人，很少有人会来这里。

scripts.text: You must feel the compassion of our Buddha!
scripts.translation: 愿您感受到我们佛陀的慈悲！

scripts.text: Buddha is our God from Dewata myth, he is the king of souls and also the leader of good Gods.
scripts.translation: 佛陀是德瓦他神话中的神明，他是众灵之王，也是众善神的领袖。

scripts.text: Buddha is the guardian of souls whom often described in traditional dance as fighting against the magician Rangda.
scripts.translation: 佛陀是灵魂的守护者，在传统舞蹈中，他常被描绘为与魔法师朗达战斗的形象。

scripts.text: In Dewata we belive there are many deities protecting each island and tribal locale,
scripts.translation: 在德瓦他，我们相信各个岛屿和部落都有神灵守护。

scripts.text: so we do have different manifestations of the Buddha, usually described as a bear, tiger, dragon, snake, or lion
scripts.translation: 因此佛陀有各种不同的化身，通常被描绘成熊、虎、龙、蛇或狮子。

scripts.text: Great Lion is one of famous Buddhas worshipped in Dewata.
scripts.translation: 大狮子是德瓦他人供奉的著名佛陀化身之一。

scripts.text: Hope this was good explanation for you. Let me know if you have anything else you want to know.
scripts.translation: 希望我说明白了。您还有什么想了解的，尽管问。

scripts.text: This tower is built on the edge of coastal cliff. You can pray with a cool ocean breeze in your hair.
scripts.translation: 这座塔建在海边的悬崖上。您可以在此祈祷，感受清凉的海风拂过发梢。

scripts.text: Come, you should feel the compassion of our Buddha in this pleasant weather.
scripts.translation: 来吧，在这宜人的天气里，感受我们佛陀的慈悲吧。

scripts.text: These days, we have many honeymooners visiting here.
